newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westpac sees growth in phone banking.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westpac sees growth in phone banking.

text.p: Westpac Banking Corp chief executive Bob Joss on Tuesday forecast strong growth in the bank's telephone banking service.

"We see very strong growth in the years ahead in the amounts of business done on our telephone banking network, an ideal medium for rural people," Joss told a National Farmers Federation (NFF) conference in Canberra.
The bank expected more business, rural and non-rural, moving into the newer forms of service delivery, such as personal computer dial-up, he said.
Joss also announced the bank would also trial its new personal computer banking product for rural and small business customers through the NFF's Farmwide Online Service Project.
"We've been developing the new windows-based banking service for some months and we're now in pilot phase," he said.

The service would allow people to look up account and transaction information, pay creditors, transfer money between accounts and organise payrolls from their own offices or studies at any time of day, he said.
